Delete chunks from a store

Source: R/store.R
dedup_delete.Rd

Removes the named chunks. An object whose manifest names a deleted chunk can no longer be read; dedup_gc() is the safe way to reclaim space.

Usage

dedup_delete(store, hashes)

Arguments

store

A dedup_store() or dedup_backend().

hashes

Chunk digests, as lower-case hex.

Value

store, invisibly.

Examples

store <- dedup_store(tempfile(), create = TRUE)
m <- dedup_put(store, charToRaw("hello"))
dedup_delete(store, m$hashes)
dedup_has(store, m$hashes)
#> [1] FALSE
